decisions.reason: Packaging all files in a ZIP named v25 does not change the required style-system coverage or additions.
The package version designation does not revise the legacy copy-paste behavior, test sources, or previously specified V14 test target.
The delivery packaging instruction does not alter the earlier task-local due-diligence assessment or its outputs.
The source changes archive packaging and version naming but establishes no new bullet appearance rule.
The v25 package instruction does not resolve or modify the required Tab-controlled list hierarchy.
The source contains no client decision changing the mechanism or handling of editable text fields.
Packaging the files as v25 does not change any typography or style-spacing attributes.
The package modification does not change the approved theme colors or color-availability policy.
The source does not alter the requirement that tables and columns remain within page bounds.
The complete-folder and v25 instructions do not modify field-label content, coverage, placement, or persistence.
The package change does not establish a new paragraph, Enter-key, or line-spacing rule.
The packaging instruction does not change the established Board Meeting row-extension workflow.
